comment: Difficulty levels for AutoC&C test battles.
Tiberian Dawn's bots are personalities, not difficulty tiers, so a level is a personality
plus a handicap. OpenRA's handicap is a 0-95% penalty in 5% steps that scales a player's
firepower, durability and build speed, so handicapping the bot makes it weaker and
handicapping the human is the only way to ask for something harder than the toughest bot.
This file is the single source of truth: scripts/run-doctrine.ps1 and the launcher both
read it, so adding a level here adds it to both.

levels.name: Rookie
levels.summary: Watson at 70% handicap. Barely fights back — use it to prove a doctrine does anything at all.

levels.name: Easy
levels.summary: Watson at 45% handicap. Builds a real base but loses trades, so mistakes are survivable.

levels.name: Normal
levels.summary: Cabal at 20% handicap. A fair fight: your build order and unit mix have to be sane.

levels.name: Hard
levels.summary: HAL 9001 at full strength. Defends its base properly and punishes a slow opening.

levels.name: Brutal
levels.summary: HAL 9001 at full strength while you take a 25% handicap. The bot cannot be made stronger, so this weakens you instead.
